conviction_note: Ericsson's real report-day moves are large (B share, 12 prints since Oct 2023: median about 7.8%, last four +18.0, +10.5, -4.1, -12.6), and every report carries a new quarterly guide (Q4 Networks gross margin and seasonality), so abs_move is 8.5. The evidence is balanced. The Q3 gross-margin track record and the Transsion IPR benefit point to a small beat against Infront adj EBITA of SEK 7.9b. Component-cost inflation, which the company itself said 'builds in the coming quarters', makes a soft Q4 margin guide the likelier sign on the line that decides the move. Sell-side is already bearish (MS UW, BofA underperform), which keeps p_up near 50 at 48. The findings sum (-0.8) and the scaled number (-0.34) agree in sign; the scaled number is smaller because p_up carries the uncertainty.

positioning_check: Finansinspektionen aggregate register read 2026-10-14: 0.0% for Ericsson, no change (https://www.fi.se/sv/vara-register/blankningsregistret/GetBlankningsregisterAggregat/). This is the 0.5% truncation floor, not a measurement (anchor_covered false). No disclosed crowded short and no squeeze fuel. findings.finding: Ericsson landed Networks adjusted gross margin at 50.4% in both Q1 and Q2 2026 against a 49-51% guide each time, and in Q4 2025 at 49.6%. The same habit applied to the Q3 guide of 48-50% gives about 49.4%. Infront's group adj GM of 47.3% (Q2: 48.4%) implies Networks at roughly 48.5-49% by segment arithmetic, a small margin beat on the largest segment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: Networks adj GM 50.4% beat, but the stock fell 12.6% on the cautious Q3 margin guide and a sales miss, so margin beats here are sold when the guide disappoints. Q3 2025: gross-margin beat, stock +18.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus segment arithmetic (group adj GM 47.3%, 1.1pt below Q2) puts Networks near the lower-middle of the guide, not where the company has landed for three quarters. If this were priced, consensus group GM would sit nearer 47.8-48%. SHB's preview at SEK 8.1b EBITA (vs 7.9b) is the only sell-side number above the bar. This is an inference from segment math; the Networks GM consensus is not sourced directly, so the finding is kept small and lands inside the company's own guide.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken 5 Oct 2026 preview, adj EBITA SEK 8.1b above Infront 7.9b, 'lätta jämförelsetal': https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-shb-ser-latta-jamforelsetal-3-kv-upprepar-koprad-20261005. Q1 2026 report Networks adj GM 50.4% on a 49-51% guide: https://mb.cision.com/Main/15448/4336146/4042449.pdf

findings.finding: The Transsion global patent settlement (July 8) begins contributing in Q3 2026 by the company's own statement, and lifted annualized recurring IPR to about SEK 13.5b. Any back-royalty catch-up for the litigation period would be near-100%-margin revenue in Q3 Networks/CSS, but its size and whether it exists are undisclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: IPR one-offs have been looked through. The Q2 2025 IPR partial settlement inflated that quarter and the company has since normalised its own margin for it. The Q3 2025 +18% day included IPR from previously unlicensed periods alongside a broad margin beat.
findings.why_not_priced: The settlement was public before the Q2 report, so the recurring part is in the 27 Jul and 8 Oct Infront consensus. Only a catch-up is not priced, and analysts cannot model one that has not been quantified. If it were priced, Q3 IPR estimates would carry an explicit non-recurring line. The finding is small because a beat made of a one-off is sold (H&M lesson).
findings.independence: IAM Media 14 Jul 2026: Transsion and Verifone deals took recurring licensing to SEK 13.5b, all top-10 smartphone makers now licensed: https://www.iam-media.com/regions/sweden?page=1 (snippet_only)

findings.finding: Component-cost inflation is building into the Q4 outlook. Ericsson said in Q2 'As the impact builds in the coming quarters, we will continue to pursue internal measures and pricing actions'. Morgan Stanley (Sep 22) models gross margin falling about 100bp a year to 2028 against flat consensus. So the new Q4 Networks gross-margin range, the guidance line in this release, is more likely to come in soft than strong.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: Q3 Networks GM guide of 48-50% sat below the 49.7% consensus, and the stock fell 12.6% on the day. Jan 2026 (Q4'25 report, Q1 guide 49-51%): +10.5%. The guide line has decided the last several reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock fell from 112.75 to 91.5 after Q2, and MS's downgrade took another 3.8%. But MS says consensus margins are still about flat, and Danske (5 Oct) expects pass-through to customers. If fully priced, consensus would already show a Q4 GM step-down and the sell-side would not still be split between buy (SHB SEK 129, Danske SEK 110) and UW/underperform. Sized at guidance scale and kept at -1.5, not larger, because the bear case is the published one.
findings.independence: Morgan Stanley UW 22-23 Sep 2026, GM -100bp/yr vs flat consensus: https://investinglive.com/stocks/morgan-stanley-prefers-nokia-as-it-turns-bearish-on-ericsson/. Danske 5 Oct expects component costs to pressure margins from Q4: https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-shb-ser-latta-jamforelsetal-3-kv-upprepar-koprad-20261005. Barclays/MS July comments: https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-ericsson-faller-efter-rapport-som-inte-levde-upp-till-forvantningar-analytikerkommentarer-20260714

findings.finding: North America is softening. Morgan Stanley puts Ericsson's NA network revenue at about -5% YoY in Q2 after years of growth (Americas about 35% of group), and Danske's 5 Oct note says US operators have postponed some investments and trimmed its Q3 adj EBITA by 1%. This is a risk to Networks reaching the +6% QoQ consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 sales miss (52.7b vs higher expectations) went with the -12.6% day. Jan 2025 -12.7% was also a North America/sales-led disappointment.
findings.original_quote: Danske Bank: mer försiktig inför andra halvåret då amerikanska operatörer har skjutit upp vissa investeringar (paraphrased by WebFetch from the Swedish telegram; the page refused verbatim reproduction)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is sell-side wire copy, and the comp is easy (weak NA in Q3 2025, per SHB). Kept small because the company guided Networks above seasonality and built SEK 4.6b of inventory for planned Q3 deliveries, which argues against a Q3 sales miss. Its weight is in the Q4 commentary more than in Q3.
findings.independence: Morgan Stanley NA -5% YoY in Q2: https://investinglive.com/stocks/morgan-stanley-prefers-nokia-as-it-turns-bearish-on-ericsson/

findings.finding: Ericsson built SEK 4.6b of inventory in Q2 (inventories 30.7b vs 23.5b a year earlier) 'ahead of planned Q3 deliveries', which pushed Q2 FCF before M&A to SEK 0.4b. Those deliveries should release working capital in Q3, so FCF and cash flow from operations should rebound.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cash flow has not been the deciding line on recent Ericsson prints; the Q2 FCF of 0.4b was overshadowed by the margin guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The company's own disclosure, and consistent with its above-seasonality Networks guide, so most of it is inside guidance. What may be under-modelled is the FCF swing: the hurbra/Infront preview carries no FCF consensus and flags uncertainty ('osäkert om det ger ett starkare kassaflöde'). Kept small.
findings.independence: hurbra.se preview 12 Oct 2026 notes the spring inventory build ahead of planned deliveries: https://hurbra.se/ericsson-rapport-q3-2026-infor/

findings.finding: This is Per Narvinger's first report as CEO (from Oct 1; Ekholm stays as senior adviser to Jun 2027). The local press expects continuity and no clean-up report. Enterprise/Vonage losses (adj EBITA -0.8b in Q2) are the obvious item a new CEO could act on, and SHB says the strong balance sheet makes an Enterprise restructuring more likely. The sign of any such step is undetermined.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance under a new CEO in the sample; Vonage impairments in 2023 (SEK ~32b) came with negative days.
findings.original_quote: Det ska man inte förvänta sig när Per Narvinger efterträder Börje Ekholm. ... Tillsättningen andas kontinuitet och att fortsätta på den inslagna vägen. (That should not be expected when Per Narvinger succeeds Börje Ekholm. ... The appointment breathes continuity and staying on the chosen path.)
findings.why_not_priced: Not a mispricing; filed because it is a sourced fact about what the release can carry. It widens the distribution rather than signing it, so it is sized at 0.
findings.independence: Ericsson release 16 Jun 2026 on the CEO change: https://www.ericsson.com/sv/press-releases/2026/6/per-narvinger-appointed-new-president-and-ceo-of-ericsson-as-borje-ekholm-steps-down. SHB on Enterprise restructuring: https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-shb-ser-latta-jamforelsetal-3-kv-upprepar-koprad-20261005

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is flat (+0.07) and the 20-day run-up slightly negative (-1.41%, though +2.7% over 5 days off the Oct 1 low). My findings net slightly negative on the guidance line and slightly positive on the reported quarter, so they neither agree with nor fight the lean. The real tension is with the baseline's scale: its estimated-cadence median of 2.18% understates Ericsson's observed report-day moves (median about 7.8%) by more than three times.
